Validate alias lookup table

Source: R/validation.R
dot-validate_alias_lookup.Rd

Validates the structure and integrity of an analyte alias lookup table.

Usage

.validate_alias_lookup(
  alias_lookup = analyte_alias_lookup,
  lookup = analyte_tbl
)

Arguments

alias_lookup

Alias lookup table, typically [analyte_alias_lookup].

lookup

An analyte metadata table, typically [analyte_tbl].

Value

Invisibly returns the validated alias lookup table.

Details

The alias lookup table is used during analyte resolution to map normalized analyte aliases to canonical analyte identifiers and metadata.

Required columns are:

  • `alias`

  • `analyte_id`

  • `analyte`

  • `normalized_analyte`

  • `fraction`

Validation includes:

  • required column checks;

  • referential integrity against `analyte_tbl`;

  • duplicate alias detection;

  • character type validation;

  • missing value checks;

  • fraction validation;

  • alias normalization checks.

Valid fraction values are:

  • `"dissolved"`

  • `"total"`

  • `"filtered"`

  • `"unfiltered"`

All aliases are expected to have already been normalized using [`.normalize_analyte_text`()].

See also

[analyte_tbl], [analyte_alias_lookup], [`.normalize_analyte_text`()]
